denominator: Every unique (doc_name, para_idx) paragraph key in the period, including paragraphs assigned no topic.

normalization.rule: taxonomy_v1-backed casefold normalization; unknown labels raise; duplicate canonical labels within a paragraph are removed
normalization.composite_rule: A paragraph counts once when it carries one or more constituent labels; marginal topic intervals are never combined.

paired_model.composition_rule: Published bounds widen sampling bounds by the paired-model half-range when paired support and a sampling interval exist; bounds never narrow.
